architecture: Both outputs exp10(min(raw,0)). log_exp retains51c18->32->11 plus linear skip. log_local uses channel-local masks: each output sees only its1or2 gates via3dedicated hidden units plus masked skip, same padded arrays and initial matrices. No analytic coefficients fixed in learned candidates.
loss_definition: Same balanced channel/decade row stream across all arms. hybrid1=logMSE/900+absoluteMSE. relative_hybrid adds mean(asinh((prediction-target)/max(target,1e-4))^2).1e-4 is training scale only, not evaluation floor or threshold. Common development selection score=logMSE/900+absoluteMSE+asinh-relativeMSE for all arms; fresh never selects.
oracle: Fixed analytic log-linear coefficients from known channel powers only as nonselectable positive control, predicts openings directly from log gates. Zero handling separate; no claim this is a learned solution. Test against exact product on all fresh rows.

hypotheses.claim: Cross-channel readout interference impedes learning the simple channel-local map.
hypotheses.contrast: log_local versus log_exp, identical objective and sample stream.

hypotheses.claim: Absolute-plus-log loss underweights relative current precision in intermediate regimes.
hypotheses.contrast: relative_hybrid versus hybrid1 at fixed mask; per-channel errors and tiny/large tradeoff.

hypotheses.claim: Residual error is numerical or absent function expressivity rather than learning.
hypotheses.contrast: Nonselectable exact log-linear oracle against product; checkpoint500/1500/3000/5000 curves, no claim oracle success proves optimizer learnability.

cost.scope: Padded packed static evaluation vs analytic product, not per-model speedup.

limitations: Static full physical gates only; no temporal recurrence or memory conclusion. Masks change inductive bias, not temporal abstraction. Training1e-4 denominator is not an evaluation tolerance. Separate reachable and synthetic; no new P qualification.
